findings_qualitative.value: Aperture-centered IMR increases with cluster age; CO-centered WVT IMR decreases with age, attributed to selection bias and line-of-sight contamination

evidence.quote: This resulted in a monotonically increasing trend of IMR with age

findings_qualitative.value: IMR shows strong dependence on extinction but not on CO surface density

evidence.quote: There is no observed dependence of IMR( _t_ ) on surface density, but a strong dependence on extinction.

claims.hypothesis: Do few clusters have SFE>0.2, implying few remain bound?
claims.experiment: IMR in 25/50 pc apertures and WVT bins
claims.result: Only ~8 clusters with IMR>10%; 2/5 youngest massive clusters have IMR≳0.5
claims.finding: Only a small fraction of clusters likely remain bound

evidence.quote: We find that only a small number of clusters appear to have IMR(0) = SFE _>_ 0 _._ 2, which suggests that only a small fraction of these clusters will remain bound.

claims.hypothesis: How fast is CO cleared around clusters?
claims.result: Some clusters cleared by 10^6.7 yr, majority by 10^7.5 yr

evidence.loc: 6.3 Clearing Timescales for the CO Gas
evidence.quote: By ages of _∼_ 10 [7] _[.]_ [5] years, this is true for the majority of clusters.

claims.hypothesis: Does IMR depend on CO surface brightness or extinction?
claims.experiment: IMR vs bin surface density and A814
claims.result: No correlation with surface density; clear increase with extinction

evidence.loc: 5.5 Dependence of IMR on surface brightness and extinction
evidence.quote: We see a clear trend across all SGMCs of increasing IMR with extinction

why_this_method.value: WVT chosen as objective, adaptive binning following CO emission rather than by-eye regions or Cartesian grid

evidence.quote: we believe this introduces biases due to the subjective opinions of differing authors

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Starburst99 and ensemble-median M/L approaches rejected; Cartesian grid and standard Voronoi tessellation rejected

evidence.quote: we found that this method was not robust.

limitations_admitted.value: Stellar mass of youngest clusters underestimated owing to dust; line-of-sight contamination; no formal errors possible

evidence.quote: Complicated and unknown uncertainties in both the stellar and gas mass calculations make estimating formal errors on the resulting IMR nearly impossible.
